date_note: The page gives only its publication day.
title: Apiiro: Claude Code 'don't ask again' approvals left secrets in public GitHub settings files
summary: Apiiro researcher Shmulik Cohen writes that public GitHub holds 104,185 copies of Claude Code's .claude/settings.local.json in 103,617 repositories, and 1,122 held a real secret. Counting git history, shared settings and agent transcripts, the count rose to 2,539 distinct secrets in 1,994 repositories. The article says Anthropic shipped a Claude Code update in mid-November; it carries no statement from Anthropic.
plain: Apiiro says Claude Code's 'don't ask again' option saved secrets typed into commands in a settings file, and some of those files are public on GitHub. The article says Anthropic shipped an update in mid-November.
exec: Apiiro reports 2,539 distinct secrets in 1,994 repositories, found through agent settings files.
action: The article advises deleting any rule containing a secret from .claude/settings.local.json, rotating the exposed credentials and scanning agent folders in pre-commit and CI.

validation.note: One article, written by an Apiiro researcher and syndicated on SecurityBrief Australia, New Zealand and Asia (one publisher). Apiiro's own report and Anthropic's release notes were not read.
